replacements.new: The signing connection preserves original randomizers, exact replay and the declared signing-owner observation interface. It has an exact classical reduction through native deterministic RFC 6979 P-256 and an ordinary-unforgeability reduction for native hedged ML-DSA in the shared random-XOF model, including quantum public queries. The ML-DSA proof jointly handles key generation and the retained-randomizer hedge, with explicit oracle and hidden-draw collision terms. The complete private-invocation ledger, source map, finite controls and independent proof review accompany these results.
